title: Mattel Hot Wheels 2007 Designers Challenge Honda Racer White 40th Anniversary
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Diecast & Toy Vehicles:Cars, Trucks & Vans:Contemporary Manufacture
descriptionText: The Mattel Hot Wheels 2007 Designers Challenge Honda Racer in white commemorates the 40th anniversary of Hot Wheels Designs. This 1:64 scale diecast toy vehicle features a Honda Racer model, designed by Hot Wheels brand. With its sleek white color and detailed design, this collectible item appeals to enthusiasts of contemporary manufactured cars, trucks, and vans. Perfect for both play and display, this Hot Wheels car celebrates the iconic partnership between Hot Wheels and Honda.
